senses.meaning: In serious trouble because a situation is going badly
Emphasizing that a statement is honest or not exaggerated
Expressing a mild feeling or preference without making a big deal of it
Suspicious or giving a reason to doubt something
Tell the interesting details behind a situation
Staying on someone's mind and coming back repeatedly
Notice how people are feeling and adjust what you do
Mediocre or less impressive than expected
Fully focused on a task or activity
Abruptly stopped communicating without explaining why

questions.author: @miramoments
questions.body: I promised the tutor our edit was finished. Just opened the upload and it's yesterday's blank draft. I'm cooked.
questions.reply: The tutor has already opened the folder for grading.
questions.question: What does Mira expect now?
options: A chance to help a group that hasn't finished.
Serious trouble over the wrong file.
A new assignment from the tutor.
A chance to start a practice version.
questions.explanation: Grading has begun, and Mira submitted the wrong file.

questions.author: @benchside
questions.body: No cap, I was behind the goal and heard the ball scrape both posts before it went in.
questions.reply: The replay from that end just went up.
questions.question: What does Ben want readers to understand?
options: He is repeating an official score announcement.
He wants people to stop talking about the goal.
He is guessing where the shot went.
He really witnessed that unusually close goal.
questions.explanation: Ben emphasizes the honesty of a surprising detail he witnessed.

questions.author: @miramoments
questions.body: I'm lowkey excited to spend Sunday at home with the windows open and nowhere to be.
questions.reply: You can leave the weekend poll unanswered for now.
questions.question: How does Mira express her excitement?
options: She shares a quiet feeling without making a fuss.
She insists everyone stay home too.
She announces a firm plan for the whole group.
She admits she dislikes the idea of staying home.
questions.explanation: Mira shares a modest feeling about a quiet Sunday.

questions.author: @ariatwork
questions.body: That message asking for the handoff file is sus. It has the client's logo but came from an address I've never seen.
questions.reply: The client usually writes in the existing project thread.
questions.question: What is Ari suggesting about the message?
options: It is an urgent but routine reminder.
It follows the usual rules for handoff messages.
There is reason to doubt that the client sent it.
The client forgot to specify the format for the file.
questions.explanation: The unfamiliar address and unexpected message give Ari grounds to doubt its origin.

questions.author: @justjo
questions.body: You said the group dinner moved twice in one hour, then deleted your message. Sam, spill the tea.
questions.reply: At least let me get off this bus before I tell you.
questions.question: What does Jo want from Sam?
options: A reservation somewhere quieter.
The story behind the confusing dinner changes.
A list of what the restaurant serves.
Permission to remove more messages from the chat.
questions.explanation: Jo is asking for the interesting details behind what happened.

questions.author: @lilalistens
questions.body: That two-note piano line from the show lives rent-free in my head. I was humming it while folding chairs this morning.
questions.reply: It was only in one scene, wasn't it?
questions.question: What happened to the piano line for Lila?
options: It keeps coming back to her mind.
She needs to pay to hear the full recording.
She has forgotten what it sounded like.
She has been asked to play it at every rehearsal.
questions.explanation: Lila keeps thinking of the tune after the scene has ended.

questions.author: @naya
questions.body: Ben tried to start a victory chant right after half the class found out they had to redo the assignment. Please read the room.
questions.reply: Two people were still asking how the regrade worked.
questions.question: What does Naya want Ben to do?
options: Read the assignment to the people who have to redo it.
Ask the lecturer to move the class somewhere bigger.
Find out how many classmates passed.
Notice the classmates' mood and change how he acts.
questions.explanation: The chant clashes with a group that is upset and seeking answers.

questions.author: @sam
questions.body: Everyone hyped the new burger spot for months. The one I got was mid. I'd eat it again if we happened to be nearby.
questions.reply: So you wouldn't wait in that line a second time?
questions.question: How did Sam rate the burger?
options: It was so bad Sam couldn't finish it.
It was excellent despite the uncomfortable seating.
It was ordinary and fell short of the hype.
It was a pleasant surprise because expectations were low.
questions.explanation: Sam would still eat it but doesn't think it warrants the excitement.

questions.author: @deasays
questions.body: I'm locked in for the next hour. Notifications off, one file open, and the export checklist on paper.
questions.reply: I'll save my questions for the next handoff.
questions.question: What is Dea doing for that hour?
options: Concentrating on finishing the export.
Waiting for someone to grant access to the file.
Staying available for new calls and questions.
Reviewing whether the checklist needs replacing.
questions.explanation: Removing notifications and laying out the checklist show focused work.

questions.author: @justjo
questions.body: We agreed to look at the apartment together. Sam's cousin ghosted me after I asked what time to meet.
questions.reply: Did they ever give you another day?
questions.question: What happened after Jo asked for a time?
options: The other person replied and asked to meet elsewhere.
Jo received a formal cancellation from the landlord.
Jo stopped replying before the other person could answer.
The other person stopped replying without explaining.
questions.explanation: Jo had an active conversation that stopped at the scheduling question.

questions.author: @benchside
questions.body: One keeper injured, the backup already sent off, and eight minutes still to play. We're cooked.
questions.reply: A midfielder has borrowed the keeper's shirt.
questions.question: What is Ben saying about the team's position?
options: They're saving substitutions for a later match.
They're in deep trouble with so little cover in goal.
They have time to try a stronger formation.
They have settled the problem by choosing a midfielder.
questions.explanation: They lost both regular keepers and still have to finish the match.

questions.author: @ariatwork
questions.body: No cap, that old slide deck has last year's prices in three different tables. I checked against the approved sheet.
questions.reply: Send me the page numbers before I share it.
questions.question: How should Dea take Ari's claim?
options: Ari is asking whether last year's prices were approved.
Ari is passing on a rumor that needs a first check.
Ari means the price problem is real and isn't overstating it.
Ari deliberately left out the affected pages to save time.
questions.explanation: Ari stresses the discrepancy is genuine and cites a check against the approved sheet.

questions.author: @lilalistens
questions.body: Everyone came for the headline singer, but I'm lowkey more excited about the drummer's solo.
questions.reply: I'll save us a spot on that side of the stage.
questions.question: How does Lila present her preference?
options: As a personal preference she hasn't made a fuss about.
As a request to replace the headline singer.
As a claim about what the whole crowd wants.
As a reason to leave before the concert starts.
questions.explanation: Lila admits a preference without making it the center of attention.

questions.author: @miramoments
questions.body: The parcel notice says I missed delivery at seven, but my camera shows nobody all evening. That seems sus.
questions.reply: The notice has a different tracking number from the order.
questions.question: What does Mira think about the notice?
options: It probably confirms that the parcel arrived.
Its details give reason to question whether it is genuine.
It proves Mira gave the wrong street address.
It is a routine update that matches what she saw.
questions.explanation: The camera and notice conflict, and the tracking numbers differ.

questions.author: @lilalistens
questions.body: Opening night moved back an hour, then everyone got a laughing fit at rehearsal. Someone spill the tea.
questions.reply: You missed the argument about the borrowed fog machine.
questions.question: What is Lila asking the group to do?
options: Help move the fog machine onto the stage.
Tell her the new official call time only.
Explain how to stop laughing during a performance.
Tell her the juicy backstory to the schedule change.
questions.explanation: Lila knows the schedule changed and wants the inside story behind it.

questions.author: @miramoments
questions.body: The question I left blank in the oral exam is living rent-free in my head. I thought of the answer halfway to the bus.
questions.reply: You brought it up again at lunch too.
questions.question: What does Mira say about the exam question?
options: It will probably be removed from the score.
She has found a way to resit the exam for free.
She keeps thinking about it after the exam.
She no longer remembers why it was difficult.
questions.explanation: The moment keeps returning to Mira's thoughts across the day.

questions.author: @deasays
questions.body: The client just said the launch is delayed again. If you were about to joke about early finishes, read the room.
questions.reply: I had that slide queued up. I'll skip it.
questions.question: What does Dea want the team to consider?
options: How the client feels before making a joke.
Whether the launch slide contains the right date.
Whether the meeting room has been booked twice.
How many people at the meeting heard the old joke.
questions.explanation: The client is dealing with a setback, so the joke would land badly.

questions.author: @benchside
questions.body: The highlight reel made the match look wild. I watched the whole thing and most of it was mid. Ten good minutes, tops.
questions.reply: All the clips seem to come from the last stretch.
questions.question: How did Ben find most of the match?
options: Too hard to follow without watching the highlights first.
Better than the clips made it look.
Fairly average despite the exciting clips.
Uneven only because one team played without a keeper.
questions.explanation: Ben recognizes a few good minutes but rates the rest as mediocre.

questions.author: @miramoments
questions.body: I was locked in on the geometry proof until the bell. I didn't even notice Naya putting a snack on my desk.
questions.reply: I waved first. You were staring right through me.
questions.question: What does Mira mean about her attention?
options: She was waiting for the classroom door to be unlocked.
She chose to ignore Naya because she was upset.
She already knew the proof and was taking a break.
She was absorbed in working out the proof.
questions.explanation: Mira was focused enough that nearby activity went unnoticed.

questions.author: @ariatwork
questions.body: The freelance illustrator sent a rough sketch, then ghosted us after I asked whether they could revise the colors.
questions.reply: There hasn't been a reply in the project thread since.
questions.question: What is Ari describing?
options: The illustrator finished the revision without announcing it.
The illustrator fell silent after they had already started talking.
The client canceled the project after seeing the sketch.
The team postponed the color request because the deadline moved.
questions.explanation: The illustrator stopped replying during an ongoing exchange.

questions.author: @justjo
questions.body: We said we'd bring the birthday cake. I checked the order and the pickup is tomorrow, after the party. We're cooked.
questions.reply: The bakery is closing right now.
questions.question: What trouble does Jo see ahead?
options: They may fail to bring the cake they promised.
They expect to have more food than the guests can eat.
They have plenty of time to change the pickup.
They think the bakery used the wrong recipe.
questions.explanation: The booked pickup misses the party and the bakery is about to close.

questions.author: @miramoments
questions.body: No cap, my missing library card was inside the cookbook I haven't used since winter.
questions.reply: That's the book you checked right before you moved house?
questions.question: Why does Mira start that way?
options: To hint that someone hid the card as a joke.
To suggest that the cookbook belongs to the library.
To say she hasn't looked for the card properly yet.
To stress that the odd hiding place is really where she found it.
questions.explanation: The phrase underlines that a surprising detail is true.

questions.author: @deasays
questions.body: I'm lowkey relieved the client picked the simple version. I had no idea how we'd support all those extra screens.
questions.reply: The timeline just got easier to explain.
questions.question: How does Dea express her relief?
options: She publicly asks the client to cancel the extra work.
She signals that the decision has no effect on her.
She shares some relief without making a big announcement.
She says she is celebrating with the entire team.
questions.explanation: Dea admits some relief in a quiet work exchange.

questions.author: @sam
questions.body: Jo says the last cookie disappeared on its own, but there's a trail of crumbs to their seat. That story is sus.
questions.reply: I can explain the crumbs. Probably.
questions.question: What does Sam think of Jo's explanation?
options: It is a convincing account of where the cookie went.
It is doubtful given the crumbs.
It is an apology for forgetting to buy more cookies.
It is mainly about how the cookie tasted.
questions.explanation: The crumbs make Jo's version questionable.

questions.author: @naya
questions.body: Mira came out of the club meeting laughing. They were supposed to choose a booth idea. Spill the tea when you get back.
questions.reply: All I'll say now is that nobody voted for the giant cardboard frog.
questions.question: What is Naya asking Mira to share?
options: A formal list of every idea submitted.
An invitation to help build the booth.
What happened in the meeting and why it was funny.
The exact time and location of the next meeting.
questions.explanation: Naya wants the entertaining behind-the-scenes account.

questions.author: @ariatwork
questions.body: That typo on yesterday's demo slide is still living rent-free in my head. I caught myself rehearsing the corrected line on the train.
questions.reply: The corrected slide is in the shared folder now.
questions.question: What does Ari say about the typo?
options: Ari keeps revisiting the mistake in their thoughts.
Ari can't remember which slide had the typo.
The client wants the file sent without a charge.
The corrected line must be read aloud at the next meeting.
questions.explanation: Even after the fix, Ari is still thinking about the mistake.

questions.author: @sam
questions.body: Jo just got off a rough call. Before you start teasing them about being quiet, read the room.
questions.reply: I'd rather sit for a minute before we order.
questions.question: What is Sam asking the others to do?
options: Find a quieter table so Jo can call back.
Notice Jo's mood and hold off on teasing.
Tell Jo they have to order quickly.
Ask everyone to recount what happened on the call.
questions.explanation: Sam asks the others to react to how Jo is feeling.

questions.author: @lilalistens
questions.body: The sequel was mid. Nice lighting and two good jokes, but I forgot half the plot before we reached the bus stop.
questions.reply: Would you recommend it to the group?
questions.question: What rating does Lila imply?
options: The film was excellent despite a complicated plot.
The film was confusing because she missed the beginning.
The film was bad solely because the jokes failed.
The film was middling and not especially memorable.
questions.explanation: Lila acknowledges a couple of strengths but found the film unremarkable overall.

questions.author: @benchside
questions.body: Their keeper was locked in after halftime. Didn't look at the stands once and called every cross before it came in.
questions.reply: The defense started following those calls without hesitation.
questions.question: What does Ben say about the keeper?
options: The keeper was waiting to be substituted because of an injury.
The keeper was intensely focused on the game.
The keeper concentrated on following the crowd's instructions.
The keeper became less involved once the defense settled.
questions.explanation: The keeper watches play closely and anticipates each cross.

questions.author: @miramoments
questions.body: The person buying my desk confirmed a pickup, then ghosted me when I asked if they needed directions.
questions.reply: I'd check for one reply before holding it another day.
questions.question: What does Mira mean about the buyer?
options: They went quiet without explaining whether pickup was still happening.
They asked to collect the desk at a different address.
They canceled openly after finding another desk.
They left a message with detailed directions.
questions.explanation: The buyer had agreed to meet but stopped responding to the follow-up.
